text:
nina: noticing weird p99 wobble on the latency panel for POST /v1/generate when I filter by region=ap-southeast-1. p50/p95 flat, only p99 jumps ~3x for a few minutes. no deploys. anyone seen this pattern?

tariq: is that the console-rendered p99 or the raw query?

nina: console panel. I grabbed a snapshot: global p99=820ms, ap-southeast-1 p99=2.6s, sample_count for that slice ~2.9k.

jade: sounds like aggregation mode changed. telemetry-bot, what rollup mode kicks in at ~3k samples?

telemetry-bot: Rollup mode thresholds: tdigest for >= 10000, histogram for 1000-9999, raw-samples for <1000. (telemetry/rollups.md)

marco: so it's histogram for 2.9k. hist buckets are 75ms for this endpoint set. a small number of 1.4-2.8s fallback requests will end up in top bucket and inflate p99.

nina: confirmed after grouping by route_origin, spikes align with route_origin=fallback rows. fallback is ~0.4% of the slice but has huge latencies.

tariq: quick wins: show provenance (tdigest/histogram/raw) beside the metric and display sample_count. also surface top contributing tag (route_origin) when p99 is > 2x p95.

jade: low-effort UX: add a tooltip text like: "p99 provenance: histogram (bucket=75ms); sample_count=2900; dominant_tag=route_origin:fallback (0.4%)". That will reduce pager noise.

marco: medium-effort: change rollup blending: if a small-origin dominates tail, compute per-origin percentile then aggregate to avoid histogram coarse-bucket artifacts.

tariq: also consider preventing histogram-mode p99 from being shown without a minimum tail-sample threshold (e.g., at least 50 samples in the top 1% region).

nina: I can file a console bug with the queries + screenshots. I'll include the grouped p99s and raw histogram bucket counts. tagging @tariq @jade.

jade: thanks. One more thought: the panel could show a quick action button "split by route_origin" when provenance=histo so you can immediately see whether fallback dominates.

marco: agreed. I'll add the split-by suggestion to CONSOLE-3601 (backlog). For now, add provenance + sample_count to the panel.

nina: filed CONSOLE-3599. attaching query: ```SELECT minute, count(*) n, pctl(0.99, latency_ms) p99, route_origin FROM requests WHERE region='ap-southeast-1' AND endpoint='/v1/generate' GROUP BY minute, route_origin ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 20;``` Closing for now :thumbsup:
